decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing had its own page in both years, and as a component within compatible product families it costs little to keep while it supports the core drainage range.
The floor-level shower system moved from a mention to its own page in 2019, which signals growing value in the firm's core direction toward low-profile accessible bathrooms.
The designer flagship slipped from its own page to a mention, so uncertainty remains, but it fits the firm's design-led strategy and keeping it open costs little.
The sloped shower element was only ever mentioned, which gives weak evidence of value, but it complements the floor-level systems at low holding cost, so the option is kept for now.
The backflow cellar drain advanced from its own page to the home page, which shows strong commitment and resolving uncertainty in its favor.
The air-admittance valve is a low-profile accessory that was only mentioned and lies peripheral to the shower focus, but it is cheap to keep as part of a complete drainage range.
